_maintainer_note: Where each knowledge pack in config/capability_catalog.json is downloaded from. This is a list for a person, not a downloader: this build fetches nothing from these addresses on its own. Rules: (1) LICENSE IS MANDATORY: every row names its license and the page it was read on; a license that could not be confirmed says 'license_checked': false and carries 'commercial_use': false. (2) NC MEANS NC: non-commercial and no-derivatives packs are fine for personal use at home and carry 'commercial_use': false. (3) HTTPS ONLY. (4) KIWIX ROWS USE THE UNDATED NAME: Kiwix file names carry a date, and https://download.kiwix.org/zim/<name>.zim (no folder, no date) redirects to the newest dated file, so 'source_url' and 'filename' use the undated name; 'known_good' names one dated file that is known to open in our reader. (5) size_mb is approximate, the size of the newest file. (6) Every row is 'pin': 'none' because Kiwix reissues files under the same name; check the .sha256 Kiwix publishes next to each file. (7) Kiwix ZIM files are read by our own reader; kiwix-serve is never used.
